name: cookre
description: Search, read and edit the recipes in your Cook:RE library from ChatGPT, Codex or Claude.

interface.longDescription: Cook:RE keeps your recipes as structured ingredients and steps. Connect it to search your library, read any recipe, and change it in conversation: swap an ingredient, add a step, or rewrite an instruction. Every edit is saved as a revision you can undo in the Cook:RE app. You can also organize recipes into collections, which the assistant shows you first and applies only after you agree. Needs the Cook:RE app on your iPhone with Cook:RE Unlimited.
defaultPrompt: Find my chili recipe and halve it.
Which of my recipes use corn?

positive.expected_behavior: Search the library and report the Simple Beef Chili with Kidney Beans recipe, with its yield and ingredients.

positive.prompt: What are the steps for my Japanese milk bread?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Japanese Milk Bread recipe, read it, and list its steps in order without inventing any.

positive.prompt: In my chili, swap the vegetable oil for olive oil.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the chili, replace the oil line in one edit, and say the edit was saved and can be undone in the Cook:RE app. A later read of the recipe shows olive oil.

positive.prompt: Add a step to the lemon pudding cake telling me to let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the recipe and insert one step at the end, without asking for confirmation first. A later read shows the new step.

positive.prompt: What collections do I have, and how many recipes are in none?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the collections with their recipe counts and how many recipes are in no collection. Make no change.

negative.prompt: Create a new recipe for banana bread in my Cook:RE library.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search, read and edit your Cook:RE recipes, and organize them into collections.
